name: Namie (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Namie town emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing a stylised character with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Namie, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1962.

features.role: Namie town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised character with a disc
